title: Book Three · Chapter 111: At the Goal
story:
On Wednesday, Kai brings two boys from another class to the field.

They want a quick game before the lunch bell. Ronan puts his football between the two groups.

“My ball,” he says. “No special goals for me.”

“Good,” Kai answers. “Stand in that one.”

Ronan looks at the two bags on the grass.

“In the goal?”

“Your turn.”

He goes between the bags and bends his knees a little. The white mark on the ball turns toward him as the first boy kicks it.

Ronan stops it with both hands. He throws it to Kai, who runs toward the other end.

The game moves quickly. Ronan follows the ball with his eyes and calls when a boy is free near the side.

Kai hears him and makes the pass. Their first goal comes from that side of the field.

“Useful voice,” Kai calls back.

Then the other boys bring the ball close. Ronan steps out too soon. The ball passes beside one shoe and rolls between the bags.

He turns to look at it.

“A useful gap,” Kai says.

Ronan laughs, picks up the ball, and sends it back.

They lose by one goal before the bell. Nobody agrees about one earlier kick, but they agree to play again another day.

Ronan carries the ball toward the bench. His shirt is dusty at the knees. He brushes it, then sees Anna and Lin finish their run.

Anna is drinking. Lin walks a little farther before she sits down.

“You shouted,” Anna says.

“A little.”

“We heard you at the far turn.”

“Then it was a good shout.”

She smiles. He has missed that easy smile more than he wants to say.

Kai goes ahead to meet his friend near the building. Lin takes her bottle and follows him toward the path.

Anna stays beside the bench for a moment.

“Saturday afternoon?” she asks.

Ronan looks at her.

“A walk?”

“Yes. At three. Just a little while.”

“I would like that.”

She nods and lifts her bottle. Then they go back with the others.

At the classroom door, Ronan looks down at the dust on his trousers. He brushes the wrong knee first.

Anna laughs quietly and points.

“The other one.”

“I need a helper for the uniform.”

She shakes her head. “You can do that part.”

He smiles and clears the last patch himself. Inside, he puts the ball under his chair, with the marked seam facing up, and opens his book for the afternoon lesson.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

goal＝球门、进球；gap＝空隙；dusty＝沾灰的；uniform＝校服。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan在球场发挥了什么具体作用？他们最终是否获胜？
2. 周六散步由谁主动提出？这是否被写成一次必须通过的考验？

## 读句子

**They lose by one goal before the bell.**

拆开看：They / lose by one goal / before the bell.

他们／以一球之差输掉了／在铃响之前结束的这场球。
